high_level_description: This image captures a group of four individuals standing together on a snowy landscape, likely at the Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa in Gulmarg, as indicated by the text at the bottom of the image. The setting is a picturesque winter scene with tall evergreen trees in the background and a clear blue sky above. The group consists of two women and two men. The woman on the left is wearing a vibrant red saree with floral patterns, while the woman next to her is dressed in a matching red saree with gold accents. Both women appear to be smiling and posing for the photo.
